hello.speaker: snagrot
hello.text: Oi! Longshanks! These are Snagrot's apples, Snagrot's fire, Snagrot's box. You want box? You give shinies. Or you give blood.

choices.text: Leave the crate and run, and I will let you keep your ears.
Fifteen gold for the box. Nobody bleeds.
The Reeve's riders are right behind me. They hang goblins.

flee.speaker: snagrot
flee.text: Gah! Snagrot was leaving anyway. Stupid box. Stupid apples. Stupid longshanks!

do.text: The goblins scatter over the hedge and are gone. The crate is yours.

trade.speaker: snagrot
trade.text: Fifteen shinies! For a box of rocks! Hee! Snagrot is a GENIUS. Take it, take it.

do.text: The goblins count the coins twice, argue, and wander off to spend them.

haggle.speaker: snagrot
haggle.text: Fifteen? Box is heavy. Heavy is THIRTY.

choices.text: Then we do this the other way.

trade_thirty.speaker: snagrot
trade_thirty.text: Thirty! Snagrot is a genius TWICE.
